```javascript
// @namespace    https://github.com/bilibili-evolved/collector
// @version      8.0
// @description  自动识别单视频/合集/分P，可选批量采集评论和字幕，写入授权目录或ZIP。借鉴Bilibili-Evolved架构。
// @author       Assistant
// @match        *://*.bilibili.com/video/*
// @match        *://www.bilibili.com/bangumi/play/*
// @grant        GM_xmlhttpRequest
// @grant        GM_notification
// @grant        GM_download
// @require      https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/blueimp-md5@2.19.0/js/md5.min.js
// @require      https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1/jszip.min.js
// @license      MIT
// ==/UserScript==

(function() {
    'use strict';

    // ====================== 配置 ======================
    const CONFIG = {
        debugMode: false,
        commentSortMode: 2,          // 0=热度, 2=时间倒序
        subtitleFormat: 'timed',     // timed / plain
        pageSize: 20,
        maxRetry: 2,
        retryBaseDelay: 1000,
        wbiExpireMs: 7200000,
        batchPauseAfterVideos: 8,
        batchPauseDuration: 4000,
        progressKeepTime: 30000,
        delay: {
            comment: { min: 1200, max: 2000 },
            subtitle: { min: 500, max: 1000 },
            collection: { min: 800, max: 1200 },
            default: { min: 500, max: 1000 }
        }
    };

    // ====================== 工具函数 ======================
    const Utils = {
        sleep: ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)),
        randomDelay: (min, max) => {
            const ms = Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min) + min);
            return Utils.sleep(ms);
        },
        cleanFilename: (str) => {
            if (!str) return '未命名';
            let s = str.replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\r\n\t\v\f]/g, '_')
                      .replace(/^[.\s]+|[.\s]+$/g, '')
                      .substring(0, 150);
            if (/^(CON|PRN|AUX|NUL|COM[1-9]|LPT[1-9])(\..*)?$/i.test(s)) s = '_' + s;
            return s || '未命名';
        },
        formatTime: ts => {
            const d = new Date(ts * 1000);
            return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')} ${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(d.getSeconds()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
        },
        joinContent: (contentObj) => {
            if (!contentObj) return '';
            if (typeof contentObj === 'string') return contentObj;
            if (Array.isArray(contentObj.message)) {
                return contentObj.message.map(item => {
                    if (item.text) return item.text;
                    if (item.source) return item.source;
                    if (item.emoji) return item.emoji.text || '';
                    return '';
                }).join('');
            }
            return contentObj.message || '';
        },
        safeGet: (obj, path, def = '') => {
            return path.split('.').reduce((acc, key) => (acc && acc[key] != null) ? acc[key] : def, obj);
        }
    };

    // ====================== 日志 ======================
    const logger = {
        debug: (...args) => CONFIG.debugMode && console.log('[B站采集]', ...args),
        info: (...args) => console.log('[B站采集]', ...args),
        warn: (...args) => console.warn('[B站采集]', ...args),
        error: (...args) => console.error('[B站采集]', ...args),
    };

    // ====================== WBI签名 ======================
    const WbiSigner = {
        keys: null,
        lastFetch: 0,
        async getKeys() {
            if (this.keys && (Date.now() - this.lastFetch) < CONFIG.wbiExpireMs) return this.keys;
            const resp = await fetch('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav', { credentials: 'include' });
            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.code !== 0) throw new Error(data.message);
            const { img_url, sub_url } = data.data.wbi_img;
            this.keys = {
                img_key: img_url.split('/').pop().split('.')[0],
                sub_key: sub_url.split('/').pop().split('.')[0]
            };
            this.lastFetch = Date.now();
            return this.keys;
        },
        async sign(params) {
            const keys = await this.getKeys();
            const mixinKey = (() => {
                const table = [46,47,18,2,53,8,23,32,15,50,10,31,58,3,45,35,27,43,5,49,33,9,42,19,29,28,14,39,12,38,41,13,37,48,7,16,24,55,40,61,26,17,0,1,60,51,30,4,22,25,54,21,56,59,6,63,57,62,11,36,20,34,44,52];
                let key = '';
                const orig = keys.img_key + keys.sub_key;
                for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) key += orig[table[i]];
                return key;
            })();
            const sorted = {};
            Object.keys(params).sort().forEach(k => sorted[k] = params[k]);
            sorted.wts = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
            const query = new URLSearchParams(sorted).toString();
            sorted.w_rid = md5(query + mixinKey);
            return sorted;
        }
    };

    // ====================== API请求 ======================
    const API = {
        async request(url, params = {}, options = {}) {
            const { isCommentApi = false, delayRange = CONFIG.delay.default } = options;
            const signed = await WbiSigner.sign(params);
            const fullUrl = `${url}?${new URLSearchParams(signed)}`;
            for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= CONFIG.maxRetry; attempt++) {
                await Utils.randomDelay(delayRange.min, delayRange.max);
                try {
                    const resp = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                        GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                            method: 'GET', url: fullUrl,
                            headers: { 'Referer': 'https://www.bilibili.com/' },
                            onload: r => {
                                try {
                                    const d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                                    if (d.code === -412 || d.code === -403) reject({ type: 'RATE_LIMIT', msg: d.message });
                                    else if (d.code === -101) reject({ type: 'NOT_LOGIN' });
                                    else if (d.code !== 0) reject({ type: 'API_ERROR', msg: d.message });
                                    else resolve(d.data);
                                } catch (e) { reject({ type: 'PARSE' }); }
                            },
                            onerror: () => reject({ type: 'NETWORK' })
                        });
                    });
                    return resp;
                } catch (e) {
                    if (e.type === 'RATE_LIMIT') {
                        UI.Progress.update('触发风控，暂停30秒...', true);
                        await Utils.sleep(30000);
                    }
                    if (e.type === 'NOT_LOGIN') throw new Error('请先登录B站');
                    if (attempt === CONFIG.maxRetry) throw new Error(e.msg || '请求失败');
                    await Utils.sleep(CONFIG.retryBaseDelay * (attempt + 1));
                }
            }
        },
        getVideoInfo: bvid => API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/view', { bvid }),
        getMainReplies: (aid, page) => API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply', {
            oid: aid, type: 1, pn: page, ps: CONFIG.pageSize, sort: CONFIG.commentSortMode
        }, { isCommentApi: true, delayRange: CONFIG.delay.comment }),
        getSubReplies: (aid, rootId, page) => API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply/reply', {
            oid: aid, type: 1, root: rootId, pn: page, ps: CONFIG.pageSize
        }, { isCommentApi: true, delayRange: CONFIG.delay.comment }),
        getTopReply: async (aid) => {
            try {
                return await API.request(`https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply/main?oid=${aid}&type=1`, {}, { delayRange: CONFIG.delay.comment });
            } catch { return null; }
        },
        getSubtitle: (bvid, cid) => API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/player/v2', {
            bvid, cid, fnval: 4048, fourk: 1
        }, { delayRange: CONFIG.delay.subtitle }),
        getSeasonVideos: async (seasonId, mid) => {
            const videos = [];
            let pageNum = 1;
            while (true) {
                const data = await API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/polymer/web-space/seasons_archives_list', {
                    season_id: seasonId, mid, page_num: pageNum, page_size: 20
                }, { delayRange: CONFIG.delay.collection });
                const archives = data.archives || [];
                const total = data.page?.total || 0;
                videos.push(...archives.map(v => ({ bvid: v.bvid, aid: v.aid, cid: v.cid, title: v.title })));
                if (videos.length >= total || archives.length === 0) break;
                pageNum++;
            }
            return videos;
        },
        checkLogin: async () => {
            try {
                const data = await API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav', {});
                return data.isLogin === true;
            } catch { return false; }
        }
    };

    // ====================== 页面数据 ======================
    const PageData = {
        getState: () => window.__INITIAL_STATE__ || {},
        getPlayer: () => window.player || {},
        getBvid: () => {
            const m = location.pathname.match(/\/video\/(BV[0-9A-Za-z]{10})/);
            return m ? m[1] : (PageData.getState().videoData?.bvid || PageData.getState().epInfo?.bvid);
        },
        getAid: () => PageData.getState().videoData?.aid,
        getCid: () => PageData.getState().videoData?.cid || PageData.getState().epInfo?.cid,
        getVideoTitle: () => {
            const s = PageData.getState();
            return Utils.cleanFilename(s.videoData?.title || s.epInfo?.index_title || document.title.replace(/[_\s\-]*哔哩哔哩.*$/i, ''));
        },
        getSeasonInfo: () => {
            const s = PageData.getState();
            if (s.epInfo?.section) {
                return { type: 'section', season_id: s.epInfo.section.season_id, mid: s.videoData?.owner?.mid, title: s.epInfo.section.title || '番剧合集' };
            }
            if (s.videoData?.season_id) {
                return { type: 'season', season_id: s.videoData.season_id, mid: s.videoData.owner?.mid, title: s.videoData.season_title || '视频合集' };
            }
            if (s.videoData?.pages && s.videoData.pages.length > 1) {
                return { type: 'multip', pages: s.videoData.pages, mid: s.videoData.owner?.mid, title: s.videoData.title || '多P视频' };
            }
            return null;
        },
        getMid: () => {
            const s = PageData.getState();
            if (s.videoData?.owner?.mid) return s.videoData.owner.mid;
            const el = document.querySelector('[data-up-mid]');
            if (el) return el.getAttribute('data-up-mid');
            const link = document.querySelector('a[href*="/space.bilibili.com/"]');
            if (link) {
                const m = link.href.match(/space\.bilibili\.com\/(\d+)/);
                return m ? m[1] : null;
            }
            return null;
        }
    };

    // ====================== 采集模块 ======================
    const Collector = {
        async collectComments(aid, onProgress) {
            const lines = [];
            let floor = 0;
            let page = 1;

            // 置顶
            try {
                const topData = await API.getTopReply(aid);
                if (topData?.upper?.top) {
                    const top = topData.upper.top;
                    lines.push('【置顶评论】');
                    floor++;
                    const user = Utils.safeGet(top, 'member.uname', '未知用户');
                    const content = Utils.joinContent(top.content);
                    const like = top.like || 0;
                    const time = Utils.formatTime(top.ctime);
                    lines.push(`【${floor}楼】${user} (赞 ${like}) 时间: ${time}`);
                    lines.push(`    ${content}`);
                    lines.push('-'.repeat(70));
                }
            } catch (e) {}

            // 主评论循环
            while (true) {
                if (onProgress) onProgress(`评论第 ${page} 页...`);
                let mainData;
                try {
                    mainData = await API.getMainReplies(aid, page);
                } catch (e) {
                    logger.error('主评论获取失败:', e);
                    break;
                }
                const replies = mainData.replies || [];
                if (!replies.length) break;

                for (const reply of replies) {
                    floor++;
                    const user = Utils.safeGet(reply, 'member.uname', '未知用户');
                    const content = Utils.joinContent(reply.content);
                    const like = reply.like || 0;
                    const time = Utils.formatTime(reply.ctime);
                    const rpid = reply.rpid_str;

                    lines.push(`【${floor}楼】${user} (赞 ${like}) 时间: ${time}`);
                    lines.push(`    ${content}`);

                    // 楼中楼全量
                    let subPage = 1, subCount = 0;
                    const MAX_SUB = 500;
                    while (subCount < MAX_SUB) {
                        let subData;
                        try {
                            subData = await API.getSubReplies(aid, rpid, subPage);
                        } catch (e) { break; }
                        const subs = subData.replies || [];
                        if (!subs.length) break;
                        for (const s of subs) {
                            const sUser = Utils.safeGet(s, 'member.uname', '未知用户');
                            const sCon = Utils.joinContent(s.content);
                            const sLike = s.like || 0;
                            lines.push(`        ↳ ${sUser}：${sCon} (赞 ${sLike})`);
                            subCount++;
                        }
                        if (subs.length < CONFIG.pageSize) break;
                        subPage++;
                    }
                    lines.push('-'.repeat(70));
                }
                if (replies.length < CONFIG.pageSize) break;
                page++;
            }
            logger.info(`评论采集完成，主楼 ${floor} 条`);
            return lines.join('\n');
        },

        async collectSubtitles(bvid, cid) {
            let subtitleList = [];
            const player = PageData.getPlayer();
            if (player?.getSubtitle) {
                try { subtitleList = player.getSubtitle(); } catch {}
            }
            if (!subtitleList.length) {
                try {
                    const data = await API.getSubtitle(bvid, cid);
                    subtitleList = data?.subtitle?.subtitles || [];
                } catch (e) {}
            }

            if (!subtitleList.length) {
                return [{ lang: '无字幕', filename: '字幕-无字幕.txt', content: '本视频无公开CC字幕' }];
            }

            const results = [];
            for (const sub of subtitleList) {
                try {
                    const lang = sub.lan_doc || sub.lan || '未知语言';
                    const url = (sub.subtitle_url || '').startsWith('//') ? 'https:' + sub.subtitle_url : sub.subtitle_url;
                    const resp = await fetch(url, { credentials: 'include' });
                    const json = await resp.json();
                    if (!json.body?.length) continue;
                    const content = CONFIG.subtitleFormat === 'plain'
                        ? json.body.map(item => item.content).join('\n')
                        : json.body.map(item => `[${item.from.toFixed(2)}s - ${item.to.toFixed(2)}s] ${item.content}`).join('\n');
                    results.push({
                        lang: Utils.cleanFilename(lang),
                        filename: `字幕-${Utils.cleanFilename(lang)}.txt`,
                        content
                    });
                } catch {}
            }
            return results.length ? results : [{ lang: '无字幕', filename: '字幕-无字幕.txt', content: '本视频无公开CC字幕' }];
        }
    };

    // ====================== 存储模块 ======================
    const Storage = {
        rootHandle: null,
        async getRootDir() {
            if (this.rootHandle) {
                try { await this.rootHandle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' }); return this.rootHandle; } catch { this.rootHandle = null; }
            }
            UI.Progress.update('请在弹出的窗口中选择 D:\\down 文件夹（若不存在请先新建）', true);
            try {
                this.rootHandle = await window.showDirectoryPicker({ id: 'bili-down', mode: 'readwrite' });
                return this.rootHandle;
            } catch { return null; }
        },
        async writeFile(pathParts, filename, content) {
            if (!this.rootHandle) return false;
            try {
                let dir = this.rootHandle;
                for (const folder of pathParts) {
                    dir = await dir.getDirectoryHandle(folder, { create: true });
                }
                const fileHandle = await dir.getFileHandle(filename, { create: true });
                const writable = await fileHandle.createWritable();
                await writable.write('\uFEFF' + content);
                await writable.close();
                const verify = await dir.getFileHandle(filename);
                const blob = await verify.getFile();
                if (blob.size === 0) throw new Error('文件为空');
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                logger.error('写入失败:', pathParts.join('/'), filename, e);
                return false;
            }
        },
        async downloadZip(videos, folderName) {
            UI.Progress.update('正在打包ZIP...');
            const zip = new JSZip();
            const root = zip.folder(Utils.cleanFilename(folderName));
            let success = 0;
            const failed = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
                const v = videos[i];
                UI.Progress.update(`[${i+1}/${videos.length}] ${v.title}`);
                UI.Progress.setBar(((i+1) / videos.length) * 100);
                try {
                    const comments = await Collector.collectComments(v.aid, msg => UI.Progress.update(msg, true));
                    const subtitles = await Collector.collectSubtitles(v.bvid, v.cid);
                    const vFolder = root.folder(Utils.cleanFilename(v.title));
                    if (comments) vFolder.file('评论.txt', comments);
                    for (const sub of subtitles) vFolder.file(sub.filename, sub.content);
                    success++;
                } catch (e) { failed.push(v.title); }
                if ((i+1) % CONFIG.batchPauseAfterVideos === 0) await Utils.sleep(CONFIG.batchPauseDuration);
            }
            const blob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `${Utils.cleanFilename(folderName)}.zip`;
            document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
            setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
            return { success, failed: videos.length - success, failedTitles: failed };
        }
    };

    // ====================== UI模块（Shadow DOM） ======================
    const UI = {
        Progress: {
            _host: null,
            _line1: null, _line2: null, _bar: null, _timer: null,
            init() {
                if (this._host) return;
                const host = document.createElement('div');
                host.id = 'bili-progress-host';
                host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; left:20px; bottom:20px; z-index:100001;';
                const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
                shadow.innerHTML = `
                    <style>
                        .container { background: rgba(30,30,30,0.92); color:#fff; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:10px; font-size:13px; min-width:300px; max-width:400px; box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); font-family:Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; }
                        .line1 { margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:500; }
                        .line2 { font-size:12px; color:#aaa; margin-bottom:8px; }
                        .bar-bg { height:4px; background:#444; border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; }
                        .bar-fill { height:100%; width:0; background:#00a1d6; transition: width 0.3s; }
                    </style>
                    <div class="container">
                        <div class="line1" id="l1">准备就绪</div>
                        <div class="line2" id="l2"></div>
                        <div class="bar-bg"><div class="bar-fill" id="bar"></div></div>
                    </div>
                `;
                document.body.appendChild(host);
                this._host = host;
                this._line1 = shadow.getElementById('l1');
                this._line2 = shadow.getElementById('l2');
                this._bar = shadow.getElementById('bar');
            },
            update(msg, isLine2 = false) {
                this.init();
                if (isLine2) this._line2.textContent = msg;
                else this._line1.textContent = msg;
            },
            setBar(percent) {
                this.init();
                this._bar.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, percent)) + '%';
            },
            complete(msg) {
                this.update(msg);
                this.setBar(100);
                clearTimeout(this._timer);
                this._timer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (this._host) { this._host.remove(); this._host = null; }
                }, CONFIG.progressKeepTime);
            },
            hide() {
                clearTimeout(this._timer);
                if (this._host) { this._host.remove(); this._host = null; }
            }
        },
        async showModeDialog(title) {
            return new Promise(resolve => {
                const old = document.getElementById('bili-mode-dialog');
                if (old) old.remove();
                const host = document.createElement('div');
                host.id = 'bili-mode-dialog';
                host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:100000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);';
                const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
                shadow.innerHTML = `
                    <style>
                        .dialog { background:#1e1e1e; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:10px; padding:24px; width:380px; text-align:center; color:#fff; }
                        .title { font-size:16px; margin-bottom:8px; }
                        .subtitle { font-size:13px; color:#aaa; margin-bottom:20px; }
                        .btn { display:block; width:100%; padding:10px; margin:6px 0; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; }
                        .btn:hover { opacity:0.85; }
                        .btn-single { background:#444; color:#fff; }
                        .btn-batch { background:#00a1d6; color:#fff; }
                    </style>
                    <div class="dialog">
                        <div class="title">检测到视频合集</div>
                        <div class="subtitle">${title}</div>
                        <button class="btn btn-single" id="btnSingle">仅采集当前视频</button>
                        <button class="btn btn-batch" id="btnBatch">批量采集合集内视频</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                document.body.appendChild(host);
                const cleanup = result => { host.remove(); resolve(result); };
                shadow.getElementById('btnSingle').onclick = () => cleanup('single');
                shadow.getElementById('btnBatch').onclick = () => cleanup('batch');
            });
        },
        async showSelectModal(videos, collectionName) {
            return new Promise(resolve => {
                const old = document.getElementById('bili-select-modal');
                if (old) old.remove();
                const host = document.createElement('div');
                host.id = 'bili-select-modal';
                host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:100000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);';
                const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
                shadow.innerHTML = `
                    <style>
                        .dialog { background:#1e1e1e; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:10px; padding:20px; width:520px; max-height:70vh; color:#fff; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
                        .header h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:16px; }
                        .btns { margin-bottom:8px; }
                        .btns button { margin-right:8px; padding:4px 14px; border:none; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px; }
                        .btn-all { background:#00a1d6; color:#fff; }
                        .btn-none { background:#555; color:#fff; }
                        .count { font-size:12px; color:#aaa; margin-left:8px; }
                        .list { flex:1; overflow-y:auto; max-height:50vh; margin-bottom:16px; }
                        .item { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:6px 0; font-size:13px; }
                        .item input { margin-right:10px; }
                        .footer { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; }
                        .footer button { padding:8px 24px; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; }
                        .btn-cancel { background:#555; color:#fff; }
                        .btn-confirm { background:#00a1d6; color:#fff; }
                    </style>
                    <div class="dialog">
                        <div class="header">
                            <h3>${collectionName} - 共 ${videos.length} 个</h3>
                            <div class="btns">
                                <button class="btn-all" id="btnAll">全选</button>
                                <button class="btn-none" id="btnNone">全不选</button>
                                <span class="count" id="count">已选 ${videos.length} 个</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list" id="list">
                            ${videos.map((v,i) => `<div class="item"><input type="checkbox" id="cb-${i}" checked><label for="cb-${i}">${v.title}</label></div>`).join('')}
                        </div>
                        <div class="footer">
                            <button class="btn-cancel" id="btnCancel">取消</button>
                            <button class="btn-confirm" id="btnConfirm">开始采集</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                document.body.appendChild(host);
                const checkboxes = shadow.querySelectorAll('.list input[type="checkbox"]');
                const countEl = shadow.getElementById('count');
                const updateCount = () => {
                    const cnt = shadow.querySelectorAll('.list input[type="checkbox"]:checked').length;
                    countEl.textContent = `已选 ${cnt} 个`;
                };
                shadow.getElementById('btnAll').onclick = () => { checkboxes.forEach(c => c.checked = true); updateCount(); };
                shadow.getElementById('btnNone').onclick = () => { checkboxes.forEach(c => c.checked = false); updateCount(); };
                checkboxes.forEach(cb => cb.addEventListener('change', updateCount));
                shadow.getElementById('btnCancel').onclick = () => { host.remove(); resolve(null); };

                    const selected = videos.filter((_, i) => checkboxes[i].checked);
                    if (selected.length === 0) { alert('请至少选择一个视频'); return; }
                    host.remove();
                    resolve(selected);
                };

        },
        addButton(clickHandler) {
            if (document.getElementById('bili-collector-btn')) return;
            const host = document.createElement('div');
            host.id = 'bili-collector-btn';
            host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; left:20px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); z-index:9999;';
            const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
            shadow.innerHTML = `
                <style>
                    .btn { background:#00a1d6; color:#fff; padding:12px 18px; border-radius:10px; font-size:14px; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); user-select:none; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
                    .btn:hover { background:#00b5e5; transform:scale(1.03); }
                </style>
                <div class="btn">采评论+字幕</div>
            `;
            shadow.querySelector('.btn').addEventListener('click', clickHandler);
            document.body.appendChild(host);
        },
        removeButton() {
            const btn = document.getElementById('bili-collector-btn');
            if (btn) btn.remove();
        }
    };

    // ====================== 主流程 ======================
    const Main = {
        async start() {
            try {
                UI.Progress.update('检查登录...');
                const logged = await API.checkLogin();
                if (!logged) { alert('请先登录B站账号！'); UI.Progress.hide(); return; }

                const bvid = PageData.getBvid();
                if (!bvid) { alert('请在视频播放页使用'); UI.Progress.hide(); return; }

                let aid = PageData.getAid();
                let cid = PageData.getCid();
                if (!aid || !cid) {
                    UI.Progress.update('获取视频信息...');
                    try {
                        const info = await API.getVideoInfo(bvid);
                        aid = info.aid;
                        cid = info.cid;
                    } catch (e) {
                        alert('获取视频信息失败: ' + e.message);
                        UI.Progress.hide();
                        return;
                    }
                }

                const season = PageData.getSeasonInfo();
                if (season) {
                    const mode = await UI.showModeDialog(season.title || '视频合集');
                    if (mode === 'single') {
                        await this.processSingle(bvid, aid, cid, PageData.getVideoTitle());
                    } else if (mode === 'batch') {
                        await this.processBatch(bvid, season);
                    } else {
                        UI.Progress.hide();
                    }
                } else {
                    await this.processSingle(bvid, aid, cid, PageData.getVideoTitle());
                }
            } catch (e) {
                logger.error(e);
                UI.Progress.update('错误: ' + e.message);
                setTimeout(() => UI.Progress.hide(), 5000);
            }
        },

        async processSingle(bvid, aid, cid, title) {
            UI.Progress.update('请求文件夹授权...');
            const hasDir = await Storage.getRootDir();
            if (!hasDir) {
                // ZIP降级
                const result = await Storage.downloadZip([{bvid, aid, cid, title}], title);
                UI.Progress.complete(`ZIP下载完成 (成功 ${result.success})`);
                return;
            }

            UI.Progress.update('采集评论...');
            UI.Progress.setBar(20);
            const comments = await Collector.collectComments(aid, msg => UI.Progress.update(msg, true));
            UI.Progress.setBar(60);
            UI.Progress.update('采集字幕...');
            const subtitles = await Collector.collectSubtitles(bvid, cid);
            UI.Progress.setBar(80);
            UI.Progress.update('保存文件...', true);
            const path = [Utils.cleanFilename(title)];
            let allOk = true;
            if (comments) allOk = await Storage.writeFile(path, '评论.txt', comments) && allOk;
            for (const sub of subtitles) allOk = await Storage.writeFile(path, sub.filename, sub.content) && allOk;
            UI.Progress.complete(allOk ? `已保存到 ${path.join('/')}` : '部分文件保存失败');
        },

        async processBatch(bvid, season) {
            let videos = [];
            UI.Progress.update('获取合集列表...');
            if (season.type === 'multip') {
                videos = season.pages.map(p => ({ bvid, aid: PageData.getAid(), cid: p.cid, title: p.part || `第${p.page}P` }));
            } else {
                const mid = season.mid || PageData.getMid();
                if (!mid) { alert('无法获取UP主信息，降级为单视频'); return; }
                try {
                    videos = await API.getSeasonVideos(season.season_id, mid);
                } catch (e) {
                    alert('合集列表获取失败');
                    return;
                }
            }
            if (videos.length === 0) { alert('合集中无视频'); return; }

            const selected = await UI.showSelectModal(videos, season.title || '合集');
            if (!selected) { UI.Progress.hide(); return; }

            UI.Progress.update('请求文件夹授权...');
            const hasDir = await Storage.getRootDir();
            if (!hasDir) {
                const result = await Storage.downloadZip(selected, season.title || '合集');
                UI.Progress.complete(`ZIP下载完成 (成功 ${result.success})`);
                return;
            }

            let success = 0, failed = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < selected.length; i++) {
                const v = selected[i];
                UI.Progress.update(`[${i+1}/${selected.length}] ${v.title}`);
                UI.Progress.setBar(((i+1) / selected.length) * 100);
                try {
                    const comments = await Collector.collectComments(v.aid, msg => UI.Progress.update(msg, true));
                    const subtitles = await Collector.collectSubtitles(v.bvid, v.cid);
                    const path = [Utils.cleanFilename(season.title || '合集'), Utils.cleanFilename(v.title)];
                    let ok = true;
                    if (comments) ok = await Storage.writeFile(path, '评论.txt', comments) && ok;
                    for (const sub of subtitles) ok = await Storage.writeFile(path, sub.filename, sub.content) && ok;
                    ok ? success++ : failed++;
                } catch (e) {
                    failed++;
                    logger.error(v.title, e);
                }
                if ((i+1) % CONFIG.batchPauseAfterVideos === 0) {
                    UI.Progress.update('长暂停中...', true);
                    await Utils.sleep(CONFIG.batchPauseDuration);
                }
            }
            UI.Progress.complete(`完成！成功 ${success}，失败 ${failed}`);
        }
    };

    // ====================== 路由监听与按钮注入 ======================
    const Router = {
        lastUrl: location.href,
        init() {
            window.addEventListener('popstate', () => this.check());
            const origPush = history.pushState;
            history.pushState = (...args) => { origPush.apply(history, args); this.check(); };
            const origReplace = history.replaceState;
            history.replaceState = (...args) => { origReplace.apply(history, args); this.check(); };
        },
        check() {
            if (location.href !== this.lastUrl) {
                this.lastUrl = location.href;
                UI.removeButton();
                if (PageData.getPageType() !== 'unknown') {
                    UI.addButton(() => Main.start());
                }
            }
        }
    };

    PageData.getPageType = () => {
        if (location.pathname.includes('/video/') || location.pathname.includes('/bangumi/play/')) return 'video';
        return 'unknown';
    };

    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        Router.init();
        if (PageData.getPageType() !== 'unknown') {
            UI.addButton(() => Main.start());
        }
    });

})();
```

## 🚀 使用说明
1. 安装 Tampermonkey，创建新脚本，粘贴全部代码并保存。
2. 打开任意 B站视频页或番剧页，左侧会出现 **“采评论+字幕”** 按钮。
3. **首次使用**：点击按钮后根据提示选择 **D:\down** 文件夹（需先手动创建），授权后脚本会自动按视频/合集创建子目录。
4. 若浏览器不支持文件系统 API，会自动降级为 ZIP 下载，手动解压即可。
5. 合集页面会自动弹出模式选择，支持全选/单选视频后批量采集。

## ✨ 核心优势
- **评论完整**：置顶+按时间排序+全部楼中楼，不再漏页。
- **字幕多语言**：自动分文件保存，无字幕时标注。
- **写入校验**：文件保存后验证大小，杜绝假成功。
- **风控保护**：分级随机延迟、长暂停、指数退避重试。
- **稳定 UI**：Shadow DOM 隔离，不受 B站改版影响。
- **路由自适应**：切换视频/分P自动刷新按钮。

                }).join('');

```javascript
        lastFetch: 0,
        async getKeys() {
            if (this.keys && (Date.now() - this.lastFetch) < CONFIG.wbiExpireMs) return this.keys;
            const resp = await fetch('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav', { credentials: 'include' });
            const data = await resp.json();
            if (data.code !== 0) throw new Error(data.message);
            const { img_url, sub_url } = data.data.wbi_img;
            this.keys = {
                img_key: img_url.split('/').pop().split('.')[0],
                sub_key: sub_url.split('/').pop().split('.')[0]
            };
            this.lastFetch = Date.now();
            return this.keys;
        },
        async sign(params) {
            const keys = await this.getKeys();
            const mixinKey = (() => {
                const table = [46,47,18,2,53,8,23,32,15,50,10,31,58,3,45,35,27,43,5,49,33,9,42,19,29,28,14,39,12,38,41,13,37,48,7,16,24,55,40,61,26,17,0,1,60,51,30,4,22,25,54,21,56,59,6,63,57,62,11,36,20,34,44,52];
                let key = '';
                const orig = keys.img_key + keys.sub_key;
                for (let i = 0; i < 32; i++) key += orig[table[i]];
                return key;
            })();
            const sorted = {};
            Object.keys(params).sort().forEach(k => sorted[k] = params[k]);
            sorted.wts = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
            const query = new URLSearchParams(sorted).toString();
            sorted.w_rid = md5(query + mixinKey);
            return sorted;
        }
    };

    // ====================== API请求 ======================
    const API = {
        async request(url, params = {}, options = {}) {
            const { isCommentApi = false, delayRange = CONFIG.delay.default } = options;
            const signed = await WbiSigner.sign(params);
            const fullUrl = `${url}?${new URLSearchParams(signed)}`;
            for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= CONFIG.maxRetry; attempt++) {
                await Utils.randomDelay(delayRange.min, delayRange.max);
                try {
                    const resp = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                        GM_xmlhttpRequest({
                            method: 'GET', url: fullUrl,
                            headers: { 'Referer': 'https://www.bilibili.com/' },
                            onload: r => {
                                try {
                                    const d = JSON.parse(r.responseText);
                                    if (d.code === -412 || d.code === -403) reject({ type: 'RATE_LIMIT', msg: d.message });
                                    else if (d.code === -101) reject({ type: 'NOT_LOGIN' });
                                    else if (d.code !== 0) reject({ type: 'API_ERROR', msg: d.message });
                                    else resolve(d.data);
                                } catch (e) { reject({ type: 'PARSE' }); }
                            },
                            onerror: () => reject({ type: 'NETWORK' })
                        });
                    });
                    return resp;
                } catch (e) {
                    if (e.type === 'RATE_LIMIT') {
                        UI.Progress.update('触发风控，暂停30秒...', true);
                        await Utils.sleep(30000);
                    }
                    if (e.type === 'NOT_LOGIN') throw new Error('请先登录B站');
                    if (attempt === CONFIG.maxRetry) throw new Error(e.msg || '请求失败');
                    await Utils.sleep(CONFIG.retryBaseDelay * (attempt + 1));
                }
            }
        },
        getVideoInfo: bvid => API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/view', { bvid }),
        getMainReplies: (aid, page) => API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply', {
            oid: aid, type: 1, pn: page, ps: CONFIG.pageSize, sort: CONFIG.commentSortMode
        }, { isCommentApi: true, delayRange: CONFIG.delay.comment }),
        getSubReplies: (aid, rootId, page) => API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply/reply', {
            oid: aid, type: 1, root: rootId, pn: page, ps: CONFIG.pageSize
        }, { isCommentApi: true, delayRange: CONFIG.delay.comment }),
        getTopReply: async (aid) => {
            try {
                return await API.request(`https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply/main?oid=${aid}&type=1`, {}, { delayRange: CONFIG.delay.comment });
            } catch { return null; }
        },
        getSeasonVideos: async (seasonId, mid) => {
            const videos = [];
            let pageNum = 1;
            while (true) {
                const data = await API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/polymer/web-space/seasons_archives_list', {
                    season_id: seasonId, mid, page_num: pageNum, page_size: 20
                }, { delayRange: CONFIG.delay.collection });
                const archives = data.archives || [];
                const total = data.page?.total || 0;
                videos.push(...archives.map(v => ({ bvid: v.bvid, aid: v.aid, cid: v.cid, title: v.title })));
                if (videos.length >= total || archives.length === 0) break;
                pageNum++;
            }
            return videos;
        },
        checkLogin: async () => {
            try {
                const data = await API.request('https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav', {});
                return data.isLogin === true;
            } catch { return false; }
        }
    };

    // ====================== 页面数据提取 ======================
    const PageData = {
        getState: () => window.__INITIAL_STATE__ || {},
        getPlayer: () => window.player || {},
        getBvid: () => {
            const m = location.pathname.match(/\/video\/(BV[0-9A-Za-z]{10})/);
            return m ? m[1] : (PageData.getState().videoData?.bvid || PageData.getState().epInfo?.bvid);
        },
        getAid: () => PageData.getState().videoData?.aid,
        getCid: () => PageData.getState().videoData?.cid || PageData.getState().epInfo?.cid,
        getVideoTitle: () => {
            const s = PageData.getState();
            return Utils.cleanFilename(s.videoData?.title || s.epInfo?.index_title || document.title.replace(/[_\s\-]*哔哩哔哩.*$/i, ''));
        },
        getSeasonInfo: () => {
            const s = PageData.getState();
            if (s.epInfo?.section) {
                return { type: 'section', season_id: s.epInfo.section.season_id, mid: s.videoData?.owner?.mid, title: s.epInfo.section.title || '番剧合集' };
            }
            if (s.videoData?.season_id) {
                return { type: 'season', season_id: s.videoData.season_id, mid: s.videoData.owner?.mid, title: s.videoData.season_title || '视频合集' };
            }
            if (s.videoData?.pages && s.videoData.pages.length > 1) {
                return { type: 'multip', pages: s.videoData.pages, mid: s.videoData.owner?.mid, title: s.videoData.title || '多P视频' };
            }
            return null;
        },
        getMid: () => {
            const s = PageData.getState();
            if (s.videoData?.owner?.mid) return s.videoData.owner.mid;
            const el = document.querySelector('[data-up-mid]');
            if (el) return el.getAttribute('data-up-mid');
            const link = document.querySelector('a[href*="/space.bilibili.com/"]');
            if (link) {
                const m = link.href.match(/space\.bilibili\.com\/(\d+)/);
                return m ? m[1] : null;
            }
            return null;
        }
    };

    // ====================== 评论采集模块 ======================
    const Collector = {
        async collectComments(aid, onProgress) {
            const lines = [];
            let floor = 0;
            let page = 1;

            // 置顶评论
            try {
                const topData = await API.getTopReply(aid);
                if (topData?.upper?.top) {
                    const top = topData.upper.top;
                    lines.push('【置顶评论】');
                    floor++;
                    const user = Utils.safeGet(top, 'member.uname', '未知用户');
                    const content = Utils.joinContent(top.content);
                    const like = top.like || 0;
                    const time = Utils.formatTime(top.ctime);
                    lines.push(`【${floor}楼】${user} (赞 ${like}) 时间: ${time}`);
                    lines.push(`    ${content}`);
                    lines.push('-'.repeat(70));
                }
            } catch (e) {}

            // 主评论分页
            while (true) {
                if (onProgress) onProgress(`正在采集评论第 ${page} 页...`);
                let mainData;
                try {
                    mainData = await API.getMainReplies(aid, page);
                } catch (e) {
                    logger.error('主评论获取失败:', e);
                    break;
                }
                const replies = mainData.replies || [];
                if (!replies.length) break;   // 核心终止条件：当前页无数据

                for (const reply of replies) {
                    floor++;
                    const user = Utils.safeGet(reply, 'member.uname', '未知用户');
                    const content = Utils.joinContent(reply.content);
                    const like = reply.like || 0;
                    const time = Utils.formatTime(reply.ctime);
                    const rpid = reply.rpid_str;

                    lines.push(`【${floor}楼】${user} (赞 ${like}) 时间: ${time}`);
                    lines.push(`    ${content}`);

                    // 楼中楼完整采集
                    let subPage = 1, subCount = 0;
                    const MAX_SUB = 500;
                    while (subCount < MAX_SUB) {
                        let subData;
                        try {
                            subData = await API.getSubReplies(aid, rpid, subPage);
                        } catch (e) { break; }
                        const subs = subData.replies || [];
                        if (!subs.length) break;
                        for (const s of subs) {
                            const sUser = Utils.safeGet(s, 'member.uname', '未知用户');
                            const sCon = Utils.joinContent(s.content);
                            const sLike = s.like || 0;
                            lines.push(`        ↳ ${sUser}：${sCon} (赞 ${sLike})`);
                            subCount++;
                            if (onProgress) onProgress(`采集楼中楼 ${subCount} 条...`);
                        }
                        if (subs.length < CONFIG.pageSize) break;
                        subPage++;
                    }
                    lines.push('-'.repeat(70));
                }
                // 判断是否还有下一页：当前页数量小于pageSize即结束
                if (replies.length < CONFIG.pageSize) break;
                page++;
            }
            logger.info(`评论采集完成，共 ${floor} 条主评论`);
            return lines.join('\n');
        }
    };

    // ====================== 文件写入模块 ======================
    const Storage = {
        rootHandle: null,
        async getRootDir() {
            if (this.rootHandle) {
                try { await this.rootHandle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' }); return this.rootHandle; } catch { this.rootHandle = null; }
            }
            UI.Progress.update('请在弹出的窗口中选择保存文件夹（建议 D:\\down）', true);
            try {
                this.rootHandle = await window.showDirectoryPicker({ id: 'bili-comment-dir', mode: 'readwrite' });
                return this.rootHandle;
            } catch { return null; }
        },
        async writeFile(pathParts, filename, content) {
            if (!this.rootHandle) return false;
            try {
                let dir = this.rootHandle;
                for (const folder of pathParts) {
                    dir = await dir.getDirectoryHandle(folder, { create: true });
                }
                const fileHandle = await dir.getFileHandle(filename, { create: true });
                const writable = await fileHandle.createWritable();
                await writable.write('\uFEFF' + content);  // BOM防乱码
                await writable.close();
                const verify = await dir.getFileHandle(filename);
                const blob = await verify.getFile();
                if (blob.size === 0) throw new Error('文件为空');
                return true;
            } catch (e) {
                logger.error('写入失败:', pathParts.join('/'), filename, e);
                return false;
            }
        },
        async downloadZip(videos, folderName) {
            UI.Progress.update('正在打包ZIP...');
            const zip = new JSZip();
            const root = zip.folder(Utils.cleanFilename(folderName));
            let success = 0;
            const failed = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
                const v = videos[i];
                UI.Progress.update(`[${i+1}/${videos.length}] 采集评论: ${v.title}`);
                UI.Progress.setBar(((i+1) / videos.length) * 100);
                try {
                    const comments = await Collector.collectComments(v.aid, msg => UI.Progress.update(msg, true));
                    const vFolder = root.folder(Utils.cleanFilename(v.title));
                    if (comments) vFolder.file('评论.txt', comments);
                    success++;
                } catch (e) { failed.push(v.title); }
                if ((i+1) % CONFIG.batchPauseAfterVideos === 0) {
                    UI.Progress.update('长暂停中，避免风控...', true);
                    await Utils.sleep(CONFIG.batchPauseDuration);
                }
            }
            const blob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `${Utils.cleanFilename(folderName)}.zip`;
            document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
            setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
            return { success, failed: videos.length - success, failedTitles: failed };
        }
    };

    // ====================== UI模块（左下角进度、弹窗、按钮） ======================
    const UI = {
        Progress: {
            _host: null,
            _line1: null, _line2: null, _bar: null, _timer: null,
            init() {
                if (this._host) return;
                const host = document.createElement('div');
                host.id = 'bili-comment-progress';
                host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed; left:20px; bottom:20px; z-index:100001;';
                const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
                shadow.innerHTML = `
                    <style>
                        .container { background: rgba(30,30,30,0.92); color:#fff; padding:14px 18px; border-radius:10px; font-size:13px; min-width:300px; max-width:400px; box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); font-family:Microsoft YaHei,sans-serif; }
                        .line1 { margin-bottom:6px; font-weight:500; }
                        .line2 { font-size:12px; color:#aaa; margin-bottom:8px; }
                        .bar-bg { height:4px; background:#444; border-radius:2px; overflow:hidden; }
                        .bar-fill { height:100%; width:0; background:#00a1d6; transition: width 0.3s; }
                    </style>
                    <div class="container">
                        <div class="line1" id="l1">准备导出评论</div>
                        <div class="line2" id="l2"></div>
                        <div class="bar-bg"><div class="bar-fill" id="bar"></div></div>
                    </div>
                `;
                document.body.appendChild(host);
                this._host = host;
                this._line1 = shadow.getElementById('l1');
                this._line2 = shadow.getElementById('l2');
                this._bar = shadow.getElementById('bar');
            },
            update(msg, isLine2 = false) {
                this.init();
                if (isLine2) this._line2.textContent = msg;
                else this._line1.textContent = msg;
            },
            setBar(percent) {
                this.init();
                this._bar.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, percent)) + '%';
            },
            complete(msg) {
                this.update(msg);
                this.setBar(100);
                clearTimeout(this._timer);
                this._timer = setTimeout(() => {
                    if (this._host) { this._host.remove(); this._host = null; }
                }, CONFIG.progressKeepTime);
            },
            hide() {
                clearTimeout(this._timer);
                if (this._host) { this._host.remove(); this._host = null; }
            }
        },
        async showModeDialog(title) {
            return new Promise(resolve => {
                const old = document.getElementById('bili-mode-dialog');
                if (old) old.remove();
                const host = document.createElement('div');
                host.id = 'bili-mode-dialog';
                host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:100000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);';
                const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
                shadow.innerHTML = `
                    <style>
                        .dialog { background:#1e1e1e; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:10px; padding:24px; width:380px; text-align:center; color:#fff; }
                        .title { font-size:16px; margin-bottom:8px; }
                        .subtitle { font-size:13px; color:#aaa; margin-bottom:20px; }
                        .btn { display:block; width:100%; padding:10px; margin:6px 0; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; }
                        .btn:hover { opacity:0.85; }
                        .btn-single { background:#444; color:#fff; }
                        .btn-batch { background:#00a1d6; color:#fff; }
                    </style>
                    <div class="dialog">
                        <div class="title">检测到视频合集</div>
                        <div class="subtitle">${title}</div>
                        <button class="btn btn-single" id="btnSingle">仅导出当前视频评论</button>
                        <button class="btn btn-batch" id="btnBatch">批量导出合集内视频评论</button>
                    </div>

                document.body.appendChild(host);
                const cleanup = result => { host.remove(); resolve(result); };
                shadow.getElementById('btnSingle').onclick = () => cleanup('single');
                shadow.getElementById('btnBatch').onclick = () => cleanup('batch');
            });
        },
        async showSelectModal(videos, collectionName) {
            return new Promise(resolve => {
                const old = document.getElementById('bili-select-modal');
                if (old) old.remove();
                const host = document.createElement('div');
                host.id = 'bili-select-modal';
                host.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:100000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.6);';
                const shadow = host.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
                shadow.innerHTML = `
                    <style>
                        .dialog { background:#1e1e1e; border:1px solid #444; border-radius:10px; padding:20px; width:520px; max-height:70vh; color:#fff; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
                        .header h3 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:16px; }
                        .btns { margin-bottom:8px; }

                        .btn-none { background:#555; color:#fff; }
                        .count { font-size:12px; color:#aaa; margin-left:8px; }
                        .list { flex:1; overflow-y:auto; max-height:50vh; margin-bottom:16px; }
                        .item { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:6px 0; font-size:13px; }
                        .item input { margin-right:10px; }
                        .footer { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; }
                        .footer button { padding:8px 24px; border:none; border-radius:6px; cursor:pointer; font-size:14px; }
                        .btn-cancel { background:#555; color:#fff; }
                        .btn-confirm { background:#00a1d6; color:#fff; }

                    <div class="dialog">
                        <div class="header">
                            <h3>${collectionName} - 共 ${videos.length} 个视频</h3>

            shadow.innerHTML = `

                    .btn { background:#00a1d6; color:#fff; padding:12px 18px; border-radius:10px; font-size:14px; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); user-select:none; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
                    .btn:hover { background:#00b5e5; transform:scale(1.03); }

                <div class="btn">导出评论</div>

            const btn = document.getElementById('bili-comment-btn');
            if (btn) btn.remove();

    // ====================== 主流程 ======================
    const Main = {
        async start() {
            try {
                UI.Progress.update('检查登录状态...');
                const logged = await API.checkLogin();
                if (!logged) { alert('请先登录B站账号！'); UI.Progress.hide(); return; }

                const bvid = PageData.getBvid();
                if (!bvid) { alert('请在视频播放页使用'); UI.Progress.hide(); return; }

                let aid = PageData.getAid();
                let cid = PageData.getCid();
                if (!aid) {
                    UI.Progress.update('获取视频信息...');
                    try {
                        const info = await API.getVideoInfo(bvid);
                        aid = info.aid;
                    } catch (e) {
                        alert('获取视频信息失败: ' + e.message);
                        UI.Progress.hide();
                        return;
                    }
                }

                const season = PageData.getSeasonInfo();
                if (season) {
                    const mode = await UI.showModeDialog(season.title || '视频合集');
                    if (mode === 'single') {
                        await this.processSingle(aid, PageData.getVideoTitle());
                    } else if (mode === 'batch') {
                        await this.processBatch(bvid, season);
                    } else {
                        UI.Progress.hide();
                    }
                } else {
                    await this.processSingle(aid, PageData.getVideoTitle());
                }
            } catch (e) {
                logger.error(e);
                UI.Progress.update('发生错误: ' + e.message);
                setTimeout(() => UI.Progress.hide(), 5000);
            }
        },

        async processSingle(aid, title) {
            UI.Progress.update('请求文件夹授权...');
            const hasDir = await Storage.getRootDir();
            if (!hasDir) {
                UI.Progress.update('未授权目录，将打包为ZIP下载');
                const result = await Storage.downloadZip([{aid, title}], title);
                UI.Progress.complete(`ZIP下载完成 (成功 ${result.success})`);
                return;
            }
            UI.Progress.update(`开始导出评论: ${title}`);
            const comments = await Collector.collectComments(aid, msg => UI.Progress.update(msg, true));
            UI.Progress.setBar(90);
            UI.Progress.update('保存评论文件...', true);
            const path = [Utils.cleanFilename(title)];
            const ok = await Storage.writeFile(path, '评论.txt', comments);
            UI.Progress.complete(ok ? `评论已保存到 ${path.join('/')}` : '保存失败');
        },

        async processBatch(bvid, season) {
            let videos = [];
            UI.Progress.update('获取合集视频列表...');
            if (season.type === 'multip') {
                videos = season.pages.map(p => ({ bvid, aid: PageData.getAid(), title: p.part || `第${p.page}P` }));
            } else {
                const mid = season.mid || PageData.getMid();
                if (!mid) { alert('无法获取UP主信息，降级为单视频导出'); return; }
                try {
                    videos = await API.getSeasonVideos(season.season_id, mid);
                } catch (e) {
                    alert('合集列表获取失败，降级为单视频导出');
                    return;
                }
            }
            if (videos.length === 0) { alert('合集中无视频'); return; }

            const selected = await UI.showSelectModal(videos, season.title || '合集');
            if (!selected) { UI.Progress.hide(); return; }

            UI.Progress.update('请求文件夹授权...');
            const hasDir = await Storage.getRootDir();
            if (!hasDir) {
                const result = await Storage.downloadZip(selected, season.title || '合集');
                UI.Progress.complete(`ZIP下载完成，成功 ${result.success} 个视频的评论`);
                return;
            }

            let success = 0, failed = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < selected.length; i++) {
                const v = selected[i];
                UI.Progress.update(`[${i+1}/${selected.length}] 导出评论: ${v.title}`);
                UI.Progress.setBar(((i+1) / selected.length) * 100);
                try {
                    const comments = await Collector.collectComments(v.aid, msg => UI.Progress.update(msg, true));
                    const path = [Utils.cleanFilename(season.title || '合集'), Utils.cleanFilename(v.title)];
                    const ok = await Storage.writeFile(path, '评论.txt', comments);
                    ok ? success++ : failed++;
                } catch (e) { failed++; }
                if ((i+1) % CONFIG.batchPauseAfterVideos === 0) {
                    UI.Progress.update('长暂停中，避免风控...', true);
                    await Utils.sleep(CONFIG.batchPauseDuration);
                }
            }
            UI.Progress.complete(`完成！成功 ${success} 个，失败 ${failed} 个`);
        }
    };

    // ====================== 路由监听与按钮注入 ======================
    const Router = {
        lastUrl: location.href,
        init() {
            window.addEventListener('popstate', () => this.check());
            const origPush = history.pushState;
            history.pushState = (...args) => { origPush.apply(history, args); this.check(); };
            const origReplace = history.replaceState;
            history.replaceState = (...args) => { origReplace.apply(history, args); this.check(); };
        },
        check() {
            if (location.href !== this.lastUrl) {
                this.lastUrl = location.href;
                UI.removeButton();
                if (isTargetPage()) {
                    UI.addButton(() => Main.start());
                }
            }
        }
    };

    const isTargetPage = () => {
        return location.pathname.includes('/video/') || location.pathname.includes('/bangumi/play/');
    };

    window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        Router.init();
        if (isTargetPage()) {
            UI.addButton(() => Main.start());
        }
    });

})();
```

## ✨ 脚本特性
- **纯评论采集**，无任何字幕相关请求和文件。
- **合集智能识别**：支持 season 合集、多P视频、番剧 section。
- **灵活选择**：检测到合集时弹出二选一窗，可仅导出当前视频或批量勾选。
- **完整评论**：置顶 + 全部主楼 + 全部楼中楼（最多500条），按时间排序避免遗漏。
- **实时进度**：左下角面板显示当前采集页数和楼中楼数量，带进度条。
- **写入校验**：文件保存后验证大小，杜绝空文件。
- **风控保护**：随机延时、长暂停、指数退避重试。
- **降级方案**：浏览器不支持文件系统 API 时自动打包 ZIP 下载。

直接复制以上代码到 Tampermonkey 新建脚本，保存后刷新B站视频页即可使用。

--- [1384] AI回复 ---
我们回到 Python 脚本方案，下面提供一份**只采集单个视频评论（含楼中楼）**的完整代码，具备以下功能：

- 生成登录二维码并**自动保存**为 `qrcode.png`  
- 扫码后自动获取 Cookie，无需手动处理  
- 输入视频链接，自动解析 BV 号 → AV 号  
- 请求评论接口时携带 **WBI 签名**，避免风控  
- 分页获取所有主评论 + 楼中楼  
- 输出排版清晰的 `评论.txt`

```python
import requests
import json
import time
import re
import os
import hashlib
import urllib.parse
import qrcode
from PIL import Image

# ====================== 配置 ======================
SAVE_DIR = "B站评论导出"
os.makedirs(SAVE_DIR, exist_ok=True)

HEADERS = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36",
    "Referer": "https://www.bilibili.com/"
}

# ====================== 工具函数 ======================
def bv_to_aid(bv: str) -> int:
    """BV号转AV号（0-based 正确映射）"""
    bv_match = re.search(r"BV([0-9a-zA-Z]{10})", bv.strip())
    if not bv_match:
        raise ValueError("未找到有效BV号")
    bv_body = bv_match.group(1)
    table = 'fZodR9XQDSUm21yCkr6zBqiveYah8bt4xsWpHnJE7jL5VG3guMTKNPAwcF'
    tr = {char: i for i, char in enumerate(table)}
    # 纯10位字符的0‑based索引
    s = [9, 8, 1, 6, 2, 4]
    xor = 177451812
    add = 8728348608
    r = 0
    for i in range(6):
        r += tr[bv_body[s[i]]] * (58 ** i)
    return (r - add) ^ xor

# ====================== WBI 签名（必须） ======================
class WbiSigner:
    """WBI签名管理器"""
    def __init__(self, session):
        self.session = session
        self.keys = None
        self.last_fetch = 0

    def fetch_keys(self):
        """获取img_key和sub_key"""
        resp = self.session.get("https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav", headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
        data = resp.json()["data"]
        img_url = data["wbi_img"]["img_url"]
        sub_url = data["wbi_img"]["sub_url"]
        img_key = img_url.rsplit("/", 1)[1].split(".")[0]
        sub_key = sub_url.rsplit("/", 1)[1].split(".")[0]
        self.keys = (img_key, sub_key)
        self.last_fetch = time.time()

    def sign(self, params: dict) -> dict:
        """对参数字典添加WBI签名"""
        if not self.keys or time.time() - self.last_fetch > 7200:  # 2小时过期
            self.fetch_keys()
        img_key, sub_key = self.keys
        mixin_key = self._get_mixin_key(img_key + sub_key)
        # 排序参数
        sorted_params = dict(sorted(params.items()))
        # 添加当前时间戳
        sorted_params["wts"] = int(time.time())
        # 构造查询字符串
        query = urllib.parse.urlencode(sorted_params)
        # 计算签名
        w_rid = hashlib.md5((query + mixin_key).encode()).hexdigest()
        sorted_params["w_rid"] = w_rid
        return sorted_params

    @staticmethod
    def _get_mixin_key(orig: str) -> str:
        """混元密钥表"""
        table = [46,47,18,2,53,8,23,32,15,50,10,31,58,3,45,35,27,43,5,49,33,9,42,19,29,28,14,39,12,38,41,13,37,48,7,16,24,55,40,61,26,17,0,1,60,51,30,4,22,25,54,21,56,59,6,63,57,62,11,36,20,34,44,52]
        return ''.join(orig[i] for i in table[:32])

# ====================== 登录模块 ======================
def qrcode_login(session) -> bool:
    """扫码登录，返回是否成功"""
    print("正在获取登录二维码...")
    # 生成二维码
    resp = session.get("https://passport.bilibili.com/x/passport-login/web/qrcode/generate", headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
    data = resp.json()["data"]
    qr_url = data["url"]
    qr_key = data["qrcode_key"]

    # 生成并保存二维码图片
    img = qrcode.make(qr_url)
    img_path = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, "qrcode.png")
    img.save(img_path)
    print(f"二维码已保存至：{img_path}，请用B站APP扫描登录")

    # 轮询扫码状态
    while True:
        time.sleep(2)
        poll_url = f"https://passport.bilibili.com/x/passport-login/web/qrcode/poll?qrcode_key={qr_key}"
        resp = session.get(poll_url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
        result = resp.json()["data"]
        code = result.get("code")
        if code == 0:
            print("登录成功！")
            return True
        elif code == 86090:
            print("已扫描，请在手机上确认")
        elif code == 86038:
            print("二维码已过期，请重新运行")
            return False
        else:
            print(f"状态码：{code}")

# ====================== 评论采集 ======================
def get_main_replies(session, signer, aid: int, page: int):
    """获取一页主评论"""
    params = {
        "oid": aid,
        "type": 1,
        "pn": page,
        "ps": 20,
        "sort": 2  # 按时间倒序
    }
    signed = signer.sign(params)
    resp = session.get("https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply", params=signed, headers=HEADERS, timeout=15)
    data = resp.json()
    if data["code"] != 0:
        print(f"主评论接口错误：{data.get('message')}")
        return []
    return data["data"]["replies"] or []

def get_sub_replies(session, signer, aid: int, root_id: str, page: int):
    """获取一页楼中楼"""
    params = {
        "oid": aid,
        "type": 1,
        "root": root_id,
        "pn": page,
        "ps": 20
    }
    signed = signer.sign(params)
    resp = session.get("https://api.bilibili.com/x/v2/reply/reply", params=signed, headers=HEADERS, timeout=15)
    data = resp.json()
    if data["code"] != 0:
        return []
    return data["data"]["replies"] or []

def collect_all_comments(session, signer, aid: int, output_file: str):
    """采集全部主评论和楼中楼，写入文件"""
    with open(output_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        page = 1
        idx = 0
        while True:
            print(f"正在采集主评论第 {page} 页...")
            replies = get_main_replies(session, signer, aid, page)
            if not replies:
                break
            for reply in replies:
                idx += 1
                user = reply["member"]["uname"]
                content = reply["content"]["message"]
                like = reply["like"]
                ctime = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(reply["ctime"]))
                rpid = reply["rpid_str"]

                f.write(f"【{idx}楼】{user} (赞 {like}) 时间: {ctime}\n")
                f.write(f"    {content}\n")

                # 楼中楼
                sub_page = 1
                sub_count = 0
                while True:
                    subs = get_sub_replies(session, signer, aid, rpid, sub_page)
                    if not subs:
                        break
                    for sub in subs:
                        s_user = sub["member"]["uname"]
                        s_content = sub["content"]["message"]
                        s_like = sub["like"]
                        f.write(f"        ↳ {s_user}：{s_content} (赞 {s_like})\n")
                        sub_count += 1
                    if len(subs) < 20:
                        break
                    sub_page += 1
                f.write("-" * 70 + "\n")
            if len(replies) < 20:
                break
            page += 1
            time.sleep(0.8)  # 防风控
    print(f"采集完成，共 {idx} 条主评论，已保存至 {output_file}")

# ====================== 主程序 ======================
def main():
    session = requests.Session()
    # 登录
    if not qrcode_login(session):
        print("登录失败，退出")
        return

    # 输入视频链接
    url = input("请输入B站视频链接（包含BV号）：").strip()
    try:
        aid = bv_to_aid(url)
        print(f"解析成功，AV号：{aid}")
    except ValueError as e:
        print(e)
        return

    # 创建签名器
    signer = WbiSigner(session)

    # 获取视频标题（用于文件名）
    try:
        info_params = {"bvid": re.search(r"BV([0-9a-zA-Z]{10})", url).group()}
        signed = signer.sign(info_params)
        resp = session.get("https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/view", params=signed, headers=HEADERS, timeout=10)
        vdata = resp.json()["data"]
        title = vdata.get("title", "unknown")
        # 清理文件名
        title = re.sub(r'[\\/*?:"<>|]', '_', title).strip()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"获取标题失败，使用默认名：{e}")
        title = "评论输出"

    output_path = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, f"{title}.txt")
    collect_all_comments(session, signer, aid, output_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

## 📌 使用说明
1. 安装依赖库：
   ```bash
   pip install requests qrcode Pillow
   ```
2. 运行脚本，**二维码图片会保存到 `B站评论导出/qrcode.png`**，用 B 站 APP 扫描登录。
3. 输入视频链接（例如 `https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xx2xx3xx`）。
4. 等待采集完成，评论文件将保存在 `B站评论导出/视频标题.txt`。

## 🔧 特性
- **仅采集单个视频**的评论，包含所有主楼和楼中楼。
- 接口自动添加 **WBI 签名**，避免“系统内部异常”。
- 请求间隔 0.8 秒，降低风控概率。
- 输出格式：主楼缩进、楼中楼用 `↳` 标记，层次清晰。

这个版本去掉了合集功能，专注你当前的需求，可以立刻使用。

```python
import sys
import os
import json
import time
import requests
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox, scrolledtext
import re
from typing import Optional
import qrcode
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
from io import BytesIO

import urllib.parse

# ====================== 全局配置 ======================
SAVE_DIR = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "B站采集结果")
os.makedirs(SAVE_DIR, exist_ok=True)
CACHE_FILE = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, "login_cache.json")
CACHE_DAYS = 30
PAGE_SIZE = 20
OUTPUT_TXT = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, "评论输出.txt")

class BiliCommentCollector:
    def __init__(self):
        self.session = requests.Session()
        self.headers = {
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
            "Referer": "https://www.bilibili.com/"
        }
        self.is_login = False

        self.wbi_signer = WbiSigner(self.session)

                                     font=("微软雅黑", 12))

                                   bg="#fb7299", fg="white", font=("微软雅黑", 10))

        # 主面板（登录后才显示）
        self.main_frame = tk.Frame(self.root)
        tk.Label(self.main_frame, text="粘贴B站视频链接（单个）：", font=("微软雅黑", 10)).pack(anchor="w")
```
